text: Yeast cells contain the enzyme catalase which catalyses the breakdown of hydrogen peroxide,
releasing oxygen.
You will investigate the effect of pH on the activity of catalase in an extract from yeast cells.
You will need to immobilise the yeast cells in sodium alginate beads.
When a bead containing yeast cells is dropped into hydrogen peroxide solution the bead will sink.
As oxygen is released the bead will rise. The more oxygen released, the faster the bead will rise.
